0.0.2.title: Security release — the delegation gate 0.0.1 shipped without
notes: Everyone on 0.0.1 should upgrade now: npm install -g @xenosystem/anima@latest

Security: in 0.0.1 the SDK loop's dispatch_agent tool bypassed the permission gate, so a delegated subagent could read protected files with no prompt shown. dispatch_agent is always loaded, so the path was reachable by default.
0.0.1 also lacked the SDK-loop redaction and the rest of the per-action consent perimeter. npm versions are immutable, so 0.0.1 cannot be repaired in place — 0.0.2 is the remedy.
Fixed — the consent gate now survives delegation: the SDK's dispatch_agent is wrapped, denied risks are enforced on the child, and the parent's consent state is carried into the subagent.
Fixed — redaction now applies inside the SDK loop, and the secret scanner decodes and de-Englishes its input, with a tier no flag can override.
Fixed — the remaining per-action-consent perimeter holes.

Changed — all eight packages move to 0.0.2 together, including the four with no source change. pnpm pack rewrites workspace:* to an exact version, so a package left at 0.0.1 would permanently hard-pin the vulnerable 0.0.1 siblings back into your dependency tree.

0.0.1.title: Deprecated on npm — security: upgrade to 0.0.2
notes: DEPRECATED — do not install. Upgrade with: npm install -g @xenosystem/anima@latest
npm deprecation notice, verbatim: "Security: this build is missing the SDK dispatch_agent permission gate — a delegated subagent can read protected files with no prompt. Upgrade to 0.0.2."
First public publish of the eight Anima packages: the CLI plus the mind, soul, runtime, orchestrate, compat-soul, channels and format libraries.
